simple.meaning: קֵא (qêʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “vomit.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קֵא (H6892) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Proverbs 26:11, with occurrences in Proverbs, Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֵא (H6892) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קֵא (H6892) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קֵא (qêʼ) / H6892 is traced through Proverbs 26:11, Isaiah 19:14, Isaiah 28:8, Jeremiah 48:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6892. qe [ קֵא ] noun [masculine] what is vomited up, vomit (see Ba NB 79 ); — suffix קֵאוֺ Prov 26:11 (of dog). קִיא noun masculine id. (see Ba NB 80 ); — absolute ׳ק Isa 28:8 ; suffix קִיאוֺ 19:14 (simile); figurative Jer 48:26 (of Moab).
